claims.explanation: BMS-345541 inhibits IKK (CHUK/IKBKB), blocking NF-kB activation. Selectivity likely reflects dependence on NF-kB signaling for survival, with sensitizing features being mutations that activate NF-kB (e.g., BRAF, KRAS, EGFR, PIK3CA, MET, NF1 loss) and protective features being alterations that bypass or are independent of NF-kB (e.g., FBXW7, SF3B1, CDKN2A).

features.basis: BRAF V600E activates NF-kB; melanoma lines with BRAF are killed
KRAS activates NF-kB; KRAS-mutant lines are killed
EGFR signaling activates NF-kB; EGFR-mutant lines are killed
PI3K/AKT activates NF-kB; PIK3CA-mutant lines are killed
MET activation drives NF-kB; MET-mutant line is killed
NF1 loss activates RAS/NF-kB; NF1-mutant lines are killed
FBXW7 mutations enriched in least affected lines
SF3B1 mutations in least affected lines
CDKN2A loss in least affected lines
PTEN loss in least affected lines
NF-kB dependence; high expression predicts sensitivity
NF-kB subunit; high expression predicts sensitivity
